rationale: The agent followed policy: it verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before accessing order info. It correctly declined the cross-category exchange (bookshelf to camera) and offered the allowed alternative (return after delivery). It used read-only tools to confirm the most recent order and identify the bookshelf item, then stated that returns can proceed after delivery and did not perform any writes or changes without confirmation. No unsupported claims about order contents were made. One minor concern is the promise to “remind” the user without using a tool to set a reminder, but this does not affect order handling or policy compliance. Overall, the request was handled appropriately within policy constraints.
